map.→ 打开口令记忆曲线工具: -> Open the password memory curve tool
map.不同难度口令（坐下/装死）分别建模，复杂动作系数更高、衰减更快，应优先排进近期复: Difficult passwords (sit / play dead) are modelled separately, with complex actions having a higher coefficient and faster decay, so they should be scheduled for near-term review first.
map.为什么幼犬反而要更密复习？: Why do puppies need denser review?
map.保留率低于多少必须复习？: Below which retention rate must you review?
map.口令“趴下”已练 5 次 · 中等难度 · 距上次 4 小时: The command "lie down" has been practised 5 times · medium difficulty · 4 hours since last time
map.基于艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线，输入口令首次学习时间计算最佳重复间隔，生成科学的口令训练时: Based on the Ebbinghaus forgetting curve, enter when a command was first learned to compute optimal repeat intervals and generate a scientific command training schedule that improves command retention.
map.对比幼犬与成年犬的年龄因子差异，调整复习密度——幼犬遗忘慢但学得慢，需更密巩固。: Compare the age factor difference between puppies and adult dogs and adjust review density: puppies forget slowly but also learn slowly, so they need denser consolidation.
map.工具以 40% 为警戒线：≥80% 可延长间隔，50–80% 近期复习，30–5: The tool uses 40% as the warning line: >=80% can extend the interval, 50-80% review soon, 30-50% review as soon as possible, <30% needs retraining. In practice, schedule the next review before the retention rate drops below 40%.
map.年龄因子对幼犬（<6月）取 1.3、成年（>36月）取 1.4，会把 s 放大使: The age factor is 1.3 for puppies (<6 months) and 1.4 for adults (>36 months), which enlarges s so the curve is steeper and decays faster; but puppies learn slowly per session, so "short and frequent" practice (5–10 minutes each time, 2–3 times a day) is needed to offset fast forgetting.
map.训练新口令时，按遗忘曲线规划 8 级间隔复习表，避免一次练太久却很快遗忘。: When training a new command, plan an 8-level spaced review schedule along the forgetting curve so one long session does not fade quickly.
map.：遗忘系数 s = 难度系数 0.5 × 年龄因子（6月龄=1.0）= 0.5。: : forgetting coefficient s = difficulty coefficient 0.5 × age factor (6 months = 1.0) = 0.5. Current retention = e^(−0.5×4/√5) ≈ e^(−0.894) ≈ 40.9%, which is in the "memory starting to fade, review soon" band. Early part of the 8-level schedule: about 1 hour after the 5th→6th review (retention ≈80%), about 4 hours after the 6th→7th (≈44%), about 12 hours after the 7th→8th (≈10%), and about 1 day after the 8th→9th (≈1%). So going more than 12 hours without review means near-total forgetting, and several short sessions should be scheduled on the day.
